# TokenSpeed — Portable Triton for Multi-Silicon

## Thesis

**TokenSpeed-style portable Triton** aims at one kernel source across accelerators. Evaluate correctness, tokens/s per device, and maintenance cost. **Not installed/benchmarked here.**

## Mental model

```text
  portable Triton APIs → per-silicon backends → bake-off tables
```

## Worked examples

Checklist: correctness vs reference; perf vs vendor libs on each device; ops covered; runtime integration (vLLM/SGLang).

## Trap

**Rewriting production kernels before a bake-off.** Keep an escape hatch to vendor kernels.

## Boring rule

Adopt only after a bake-off on *your* models and hardware list.

## Try this

1. Read current upstream README for supported devices.
2. Compare with TileLang / Helion chapters.
3. Sketch a CI matrix: shapes × dtypes × devices.
